checks.ref:
command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-code.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-code stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: R2's Fix for packages/client/src/test/features/locations/locations_ui_e2e.feature (212 lines) is to move the scenario "The Here entry's request is the only one" to locations_here_entry_e2e.feature. That scenario is lines 41-48 (about 8 lines with the blank line), so the file would still have about 204 lines, over the limit the finding cites (CLAUDE.md: "Files must stay under 200 lines for AI context quality"; tasks.md header: "every file stays under 200 lines"). The Fix says "Each moved file stays under 200 lines" but never checks the source file, so it does not resolve the finding for that file. The move also contradicts tasks.md 8.3 ("add 'The Here entry's request is the only one' to locations_ui_e2e.feature"), and Fix risk does not mention this. Give a fix that brings locations_ui_e2e.feature under 200 lines (for example move more than one scenario, or split the file by aspect), state that the moved scenario breaks the location named by task 8.3, and keep the screenshot outline in place, as Fix risk already says.
